parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ='{{ $json.folder_id }}' in parents and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.document' and trashed = false

parameters.query:
-- Compare Drive's list of Docs with what the knowledge base holds. Returns only Docs that need work.
-- Only guide and ghl_help rows are looked at, so past_ticket rows can never be deleted here.
with drive as (
  select *
  from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
    as d(doc_id text, title text, modified_time timestamptz, doc_url text, source text)
),
stored as (
  select metadata->>'doc_id' as doc_id,
         min(metadata->>'source') as source,
         min(metadata->>'content_hash') as content_hash,
         min((metadata->>'updated_at')::timestamptz) as updated_at
  from documents
  where metadata->>'source' in ('guide', 'ghl_help')
  group by 1
)
select coalesce(d.doc_id, s.doc_id) as doc_id,
       d.title, d.modified_time, d.doc_url,
       coalesce(d.source, s.source) as source,
       s.content_hash as stored_hash,
       case when d.doc_id is null then 'delete' else 'process' end as action,
       case
         when d.doc_id is null then 'gone from Drive'
         when s.doc_id is null then 'new'
         when d.source is distinct from s.source then 'moved folder'
         else 'edited'
       end as reason
from drive d
full outer join stored s on s.doc_id = d.doc_id
where d.doc_id is null
   or s.doc_id is null
   or d.source is distinct from s.source
   or d.modified_time > s.updated_at;

-- Remove every passage of a Doc that is no longer in Drive. Never touches past_ticket rows.
delete from documents
where metadata->>'doc_id' = $1
  and metadata->>'source' in ('guide', 'ghl_help');

-- The Doc was touched but nothing we store changed: record the new edit time, keep the passages.
update documents
set metadata = metadata || jsonb_build_object('updated_at', $2::text)
where metadata->>'doc_id' = $1
  and metadata->>'source' in ('guide', 'ghl_help');

-- Replace all passages of one Doc in one statement: every old row goes and every new row arrives, or nothing changes.
with removed as (
  delete from documents
  where metadata->>'doc_id' = $1
    and metadata->>'source' in ('guide', 'ghl_help')
)
insert into documents (content, metadata, embedding)
select p.content,
       jsonb_build_object(
         'doc_id', $1::text, 'title', $2::text, 'heading', p.heading, 'url', $3::text,
         'source', $4::text, 'content_hash', $5::text, 'updated_at', $6::text),
       p.embedding::vector
from jsonb_to_recordset($7::jsonb) as p(content text, heading text, embedding text);
